steps.title: Log in
steps.observation: Keyboard login reached the catalog with 6 products.

steps.title: Inspect catalog and add Backpack
steps.observation: The Backpack add button was reachable by Tab and activated with Enter; the cart badge changed to 1.

steps.title: Inspect cart
steps.observation: The cart link was not reached after 40 Tab presses, so pointer automation was used only to continue; the cart then contained the selected Backpack.

steps.title: Enter checkout details
steps.observation: All three checkout fields were reached in sequence using Tab and accepted typed values.

steps.title: Review checkout and stop
steps.observation: The review page showed Total: $32.39; Finish was reachable but was deliberately not activated.

findings.summary: The cart link is skipped by keyboard focus order.
findings.observation: After activating Add to cart, 40 Tab presses cycled through the page without focusing the cart link; its DOM tabIndex was 0.
findings.expected: The cart link should be reachable in the normal Tab order.
reproduction: Tab to Add to cart for Sauce Labs Backpack and press Enter
Continue pressing Tab and attempt to reach the cart link
